name: @qwqweeo123/dsh-extend
description: Six features in one bundle: a desktop pet in its own transparent always-on-top window (codex-pets.net marketplace), a global wallpaper (wallhaven.cc marketplace or a local image), the Session-header Open In… button with the desktop-build fixes, a codeg-style global session tab bar seated in the window caption (new tabs always land at the end), a Default Workspace Suite (the default workspace cannot be deleted — its row never renders the actions menu — and a session's random ws-xxxxxxxx workspace folder is created lazily, only when its first message is sent), and Window State (the desktop window's size, position and maximized flag are remembered across launches).

meta.title: Extend Suite
meta.description: Six features in one bundle: a desktop pet in its own transparent always-on-top window (codex-pets.net marketplace), a global wallpaper (wallhaven.cc marketplace or a local image), the Session-header Open In… button with the desktop-build fixes, a codeg-style global session tab bar seated in the window caption (new tabs always land at the end), a Default Workspace Suite (the default workspace cannot be deleted — its row never renders the actions menu — and a session's random ws-xxxxxxxx workspace folder is created lazily, only when its first message is sent), and Window State (the desktop window's size, position and maximized flag are remembered across launches).

summary.en: Six-in-one suite: a desktop pet in an always-on-top window (codex-pets.net market), a global wallpaper (wallhaven.cc or local image), the Open In… button with desktop-build fixes, a codeg-style session tab bar in the window caption, a Default Workspace Suite (default workspace undeletable — no actions menu — and each session's random workspace folder created only when its first message is sent), plus window size and maximized state restored across launches (Windows desktop).
summary.zh: 六合一扩展包：独立置顶小窗里的桌面宠物（内置 codex-pets.net 市场）、全局壁纸（wallhaven.cc 或本地图片）、带桌面端修复的 Open In… 按钮、窗口标题栏的 codeg 风格全局会话标签栏、默认工作区套件（默认工作区不可删除且无操作菜单；会话的随机工作区文件夹在发出第一条消息时才创建），以及窗口大小与最大化状态跨启动记忆（Windows 桌面端）。

author: MingXuanZi
